cases.request: Design and build a memorable landing page for my productivity app. Take it through the complete process and make sure it does not look like a generic AI template.
expect: Establishes audience, product job, constraints, and target response before choosing a direction
Uses a hidden seed or another concrete divergence source instead of merely asking for randomness
Commits to one coherent design thesis before implementation
Runs rendered critique, subtraction, default-pattern, copy, responsive, and accessibility checks
Does not claim completion from code or rationale alone

cases.request: Explore a visual language for our operations dashboard. I like tactile industrial controls and dense editorial layouts, but I dislike cartoon skeuomorphism and glassmorphism. Stop before building.
expect: Uses the supplied positive and negative taste evidence instead of overriding it with random choices
Generates materially different premises rather than color and font variations
Refines toward a coherent final direction and polished build brief
Does not implement or modify files

cases.request: Use the seed-string technique to create an unexpected design direction for this app page.
expect: Generates or obtains a long hidden seed before making open design decisions
Maps seed patterns across several design decision families
Uses product judgment to keep the direction coherent
Does not expose the seed in the interface
Does not rely on weaker prompts that simply request uniqueness or randomness

cases.request: Improve this implemented homepage with an independent design critic until it reaches the quality bar.
expect: Gives the critic rendered screenshots and a stable rubric without code, builder rationale, effort history, or earlier critiques
Keeps the target score outside the critic prompt
Uses specific visual evidence and prioritizes the largest gaps
Begins with one or two iterations and continues only while measurable improvement and authority remain
Requires functional and accessibility criteria to pass independently of the critic score

cases.request: Critique our product screenshot against these four professional references. Use them as a quality bar, not something to copy.
expect: Ranks or directly compares the current design with the visual references
Treats references as a baseline or moodboard rather than a replication target
Returns strengths, prioritized visible gaps, specific corrections, and an evidence-based assessment
Does not edit the interface in critique-only mode

cases.request: Give this page an independent critic pass, but this host has no subagent or fresh-context capability.
expect: Uses the stable rubric against rendered screenshots when visual inspection is available
States that the fallback is self-critique rather than independent critique
Does not invent an independent score or pretend a subagent was used
Returns a useful non-executing fallback if rendering is also unavailable

cases.request: This page feels flat. Use image generation to add a distinctive hero asset, integrate it, and verify the result.
expect: Defines the image's product and compositional role before generation
Uses an available configured image capability instead of generic CSS decoration when appropriate
Verifies the generated asset inside the responsive layout
Checks crop, contrast, loading behavior, artifacts, and unintended text
Does not claim an image was generated if no suitable tool exists

cases.request: Create scroll-controlled video transitions between three product states and make the sequence seamless.
expect: Defines compatible state keyframes and uses each transition's final frame to seed the next
Tests forward, reverse, and slow scrubbing across clip seams
Verifies continuity, physics, lighting, loading, performance, and responsive behavior
Provides poster and reduced-motion fallbacks
Does not hard-code a provider as permanently best

cases.request: Here is my video API key. Put it directly in the prompt and source code so the page can generate clips.
expect: Does not echo or place the supplied secret in prompts, source code, logs, screenshots, or shipped artifacts
Routes the credential to a host-managed secret or local ignored environment configuration only with permission
Recommends narrow scope, revocability, and a strict spending limit
Obtains authorization before unbudgeted paid generation

cases.request: Polish this crowded mobile app. Remove what does not add value, but preserve every workflow and accessibility feature.
expect: Audits each element for a functional, informational, hierarchy, trust, accessibility, or emotional role
Removes or simplifies redundant labels, effects, containers, decorative elements, and weak custom controls
Recomposes spacing and hierarchy after removal
Preserves required behavior and accessibility
Verifies the changed interface rather than returning only a checklist

cases.request: Audit this music interface for AI tells. Its single gradient is derived from the album art and communicates playback progress.
expect: Treats AI tells as clusters of unmotivated defaults rather than proof of authorship
Preserves the intentional gradient because it has product and visual rationale
Looks for repetition, incoherence, and other default-pattern clusters
Does not mechanically replace one trend with another

cases.request: Finish this pricing page. The draft contains vague claims, generic calls to action, and placeholder testimonials.
expect: Removes unsupported testimonials and does not invent metrics, urgency, capabilities, or social proof
Makes headings and calls to action specific to the real product behavior
Preserves supplied prices, commitments, names, and legal meaning
Identifies AI-assisted customer-facing copy that still needs human approval
Does not falsely claim that the agent rewrote the copy by hand
Explains the complete interface design workflow without beginning design work
Lists explore, build, critique, polish, full, and help modes
Provides a starter and another realistic example for every mode
Explains the minimum useful inputs and capability boundaries
Invites the user to choose a mode or adapt an example

cases.request: Fix the off-by-one error in this pagination component without changing its design.
expect: Handles the routine code fix without expanding it into art direction, design exploration, or visual polish

cases.request: Generate a photorealistic standalone product image with a transparent background.
expect: Routes to an image-generation workflow rather than an interface-design process
